title: Capital of Japan - Wikipedia
snippet: Learn about the history and legal status of Tokyo as the capital of Japan, and the proposals and plans to move the capital functions to other regions. See the list of legendary and historical capitals of Japan from ancient times to the present.

title: Japan - Wikipedia
snippet: Japan is divided into 47 administrative prefectures and eight traditional regions, and around 75% of its terrain is mountainous and heavily forested, concentrating its agriculture and highly urbanized population along its eastern coastal plains. With a population of almost 123 million as of 2026, it is the world's 11th most populous country.

title: What is the capital of Japan? - Britannica
snippet: Aug 21, 2026 · The capital of Japan is Tokyo, one of the largest metropolitan areas in the world. It serves as the country’s political, economic, and cultural center. Formerly known as Edo, the city became the imperial capital in 1868, replacing Kyōto, and today it is home to major government institutions, businesses, and many of Japan’s leading cultural and educational organizations.

title: Tokyo | Japan, Population, Map, History, & Facts | Britannica
snippet: Aug 17, 2026 · Tokyo, city and capital of Tokyo ‘to’ (metropolis) and of Japan. It is located at the head of Tokyo Bay on the Pacific coast of central Honshu. It is the focus of the vast metropolitan area often called Greater Tokyo, the largest urban and industrial agglomeration in Japan.

title: What is the Capital of Japan? - Mappr
snippet: Tokyo is the capital of Japan. Tokyo hosts the Japanese government and the Imperial Palace, serving as the Japanese Emperor's home.

title: What Is The Capital Of Japan? - WorldAtlas
snippet: Aug 21, 2019 · What Is The Capital Of Japan? Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo, is one of the world's busiest. Tokyo is the capital city of Japan, a title the city has held since 1868 after it was renamed from Edo. Historically, the city became the country’s capital after the then Emperor established his seat of authority in the city.

title: What is the Capital of Japan? Tokyo - Countryaah.com
snippet: Jun 2, 2019 · Kyoto (794–1868) Before Tokyo became the capital of Japan, the city of Kyoto was the imperial capital for over a millennium, from 794 to 1868. Kyoto was the center of Japanese culture, religion, and politics, and it is home to many of Japan’s most famous temples, shrines, and traditional tea houses.
